overview: A custom thermoreflectance imaging line under construction for device-level temperature mapping and electrical probing. Spatial resolution, temporal bandwidth, wavelength set, and validated uncertainty will be reported after commissioning.
overviewZh: 在建的自主器件热反射成像平台，面向器件温度分布及电学探测联用。空间分辨率、时间带宽、探测波长和不确定度将在完成标定与验收后公布。
principle: The planned system compares device reflectance before and during electrical heating. Calibrating the material- and wavelength-dependent thermoreflectance coefficient gives temperature changes. Synchronized illumination and readout can sample repeatable transients; the installed timing performance and uncertainty must be verified during commissioning.
principleZh: 拟建系统比较器件电加热前后的反射率，利用材料与波长相关的热反射系数标定，得到温度变化。同步照明与读出可采样可重复的瞬态过程；实际时序性能与测量不确定度需在调试阶段验证。
